description: Synthetic FHIR-JSON caregiver-household feed (batch bundle): 2 RelatedPerson resources — rp-1 a spouse/primary caregiver (RoleCode SPS) and rp-2 a legal guardian (RoleCode GUARD) — each carrying only the coded relationship role and a period, identity-anchored via the seam to the member (patient reference), plus 1 malformed record missing the relationship coding (quarantine). The related person's own name is never carried (PHI-minimal): only the role code + resource ref travel downstream. No member names; patients are source ids anchored through the identity seam.
